review: Well, well, well, if it isn’t the N Corp Bums. Contempt Awe Ryoshu is quite the interesting identity with a mix of Tremor and Bleed, while also having a plethora of status effects to not only help with damage dealing but also make her tanky. Before we start, let’s start with her unique status effects: - Gaze makes the bearer take 10% additional damage and deal 10% less damage from and against Ryoshu per stack (Max 7 stacks). On the death of the bearer, this status transfers to the enemy with the least Gaze stacks and turns into Contempt stack at the next turn. - Contempt makes the bearer take 50% additional damage and deal 50% less damage from and against Ryoshu. On the death of the bearer, this status transfers to the enemy with the least Contempt stacks and turns into 7 Gaze stacks at the next turn. - Gaze of Contempt (not to be confused with Gaze) increases damage dealt by 7% for each
